propositions: Four safe Mypy settings (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores) must be enabled after revalidating diagnostics and are blocked by existing violations.
C901 function complexity ratchet with shrink-only baseline at threshold 15 must be added and wired into the lint gate.
Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rules must be enabled by making timezone sites explicit and creating shared ratchet tests.
Ruff RUF hygiene diagnostics must be enabled by clearing approved violations (RUF100, etc.) while deferring RUF001, RUF002, RUF003.
All enforcement gates (lint, typecheck, config-check, pytest tiers) must exit cleanly against current origin/main before landing.
Pre-existing diagnostics in enforced ratchet families (C901, Mypy four flags, Ruff ASYNC/DTZ, Ruff RUF) present on origin/main at land time must be resolved or captured in baselines.
